about: Cases where the JavaScript server answers differently on Node and on Bun, measured 2026-11-27 (Node 24.16.0, Bun 1.4.0). The Bun binary is what people run, so it is the reference the Rust server must equal; `--a=node --b=bun` reports these as known and fails when one stops differing, so the list only shrinks.

cases.reason: Three thousand nested levels: Node throws 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' and answers tool_error; Bun has a deeper stack and processes the request.
A 5,000-character slug: the operating-system error text differs, Node "ENAMETOOLONG: name too long, stat '<path>'" and Bun "ENAMETOOLONG: name too long, open".
An invalid OATLAS_TOOL_PROFILE throws at import: stderr carries the runtime's own uncaught-error report, whose text and stack frames differ between Node and Bun; the exit code is equal.
